hook.name: V4MineHook
hook.description: Takes a flat 3% ETH tax on every native-ETH swap: buy-side tax is intercepted in beforeSwap via a BeforeSwapDelta, sell-side tax is extracted in afterSwap via an afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated tax (ERC-6909 claims and physical ETH) can be flushed permissionlessly via normalize() to a mining-reward distributor contract.
